description: Summitline Outfitters product-demo video analyzer (pro-mode). Extends prebuilt-videoAnalyzer with a domain fieldSchema so every analyzed segment carries structured product + presenter data that we can index into AI Search downstream.

products_demonstrated.description: List of Summitline product names visibly demonstrated in this segment. Use the exact marketing name if shown on-screen or spoken (for example, 'Alpine Trekker 45L Pack', 'Ridgeline Softshell Jacket', 'Cascade 3-Season Tent').

key_features_shown.description: Concrete product features the presenter physically demonstrates or points out in this segment (for example, 'load-lifter strap', 'pit-zip vents', 'color-coded tent-pole hubs'). Skip vague marketing adjectives like 'high quality'.

scene_summary.description: One-to-three sentence natural-language summary of what happens in this segment. Include the environment (indoor studio, outdoor trail, windy field), the presenter's action, and the product being shown. Keep it factual - no marketing language.

presenter_quality.description: Short qualitative note on delivery: 'clear', 'rushed', 'off-camera', 'audio-issues', 'strong'. Pick the closest single label for this segment.

duration_seconds.description: Length of this segment in seconds, rounded to one decimal place.
